role: Registers the pickaxe, shovel, axe, hoe (one per tier material) and shears recipes into the CraftingManager.
scope_reason: Tool crafting is part of the wooden-pickaxe loop (SPEC milestone 5); no world.conf switch touches it.

members.name: RecipesTools
members.note: The recipePatterns and recipeItems tables exist only to feed addRecipes; the native side has the emitted recipes, not the builder.

members.name: recipePatterns
members.note: Shaped patterns land as recipe_def width/height plus the RECIPE_ITEMS ingredient runs.

members.name: recipeItems
members.note: The five tier materials and the five tool rows are in the generated ingredient table.

members.name: addRecipes
members.note: Registration is mirrored by csrc/engine/recipes.h:RECIPES, generated by netherite.oracle.RecipeTable from the oracle's live CraftingManager.getRecipeList() in list order, so the emitted recipes and their order match without a port of the loop.

notes: Assumption: recipes.h was generated from a vanilla CraftingManager, so the tool recipes it holds are exactly what addRecipes emits (the oracle generation is the ground truth, so a missing entry would show as a crafting probe mismatch in test_crafting.c).
